comment:
* Implemented this in order for AppCompat to be able to callback in certain situations. *

* This should be provided to * {@link AppCompatDelegate#create(android.app.Activity, AppCompatCallback)}.

methods.name: void onSupportActionModeStarted(ActionMode mode)
methods.comment:
* Called when a support action mode has been started.
     *
     * @param mode The new action mode.

methods.name: void onSupportActionModeFinished(ActionMode mode)
methods.comment:
* Called when a support action mode has finished.
     *
     * @param mode The action mode that just finished.

methods.name: ActionMode onWindowStartingSupportActionMode(ActionMode.Callback callback)
methods.comment:
* Called when a support action mode is being started for this window. Gives the
     * callback an opportunity to handle the action mode in its own unique and
     * beautiful way. If this method returns null the system can choose a way
     * to present the mode or choose not to start the mode at all.
     *
     * @param callback Callback to control the lifecycle of this action mode
     * @return The ActionMode that was started, or null if the system should present it
